title: Symbiotic Computation
teaser: Co-processing energy, information, and care across species.
description: We investigate how microbes, plants, and infrastructures co-compute environmental signals. The goal is to model symbiotic intelligence as a distributed, metabolic computation.

title: Ecological Sensing
description: We design sensing arrays that read microbial, soil, and atmospheric dynamics without disturbing local ecologies, prioritizing slow data and contextual stewardship.

title: Planetary Interfaces
teaser: Visualizing Earth-system feedback in real time.
description: We build live interfaces that surface biospheric feedback loops, creating public dashboards that reveal planetary metabolism and its thresholds.

title: Regenerative Materials
description: From mycelial scaffolds to bio-reactive textiles, we prototype materials that respond to environmental signals and repair themselves over time.

title: Interspecies Signal Translation
description: We map plant, fungal, and insect chemical signaling using ML to identify patterns that reveal cooperative behaviors and ecological stress.

title: Governance for Symbiosis
teaser: Protocols and rituals for shared planetary stewardship.
description: We co-design policy frameworks that translate ecological signals into civic protocols, enabling anticipatory governance for multi-species futures.
